purpose: Additive provider-identity transport extension for portfolio_risk_input/1. It does not resolve canonical instruments, deduplicate aliases, establish investability, size positions, or authorize actions/orders/trading.

alpaca.note: AVAILABLE means only that the exact provider pair is present; it does not mean canonical instrument identity is resolved or investable.

manual.note: An optional complete provider pair may be retained for audit, but manual input can never claim AVAILABLE and no ticker-to-provider inference is permitted.
